newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine '96 sunseed crop falls to 2.04 mln T.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine '96 sunseed crop falls to 2.04 mln T.

text.p: Ukraine's 1996 sunflower seed output fell to 2.04 million tonnes from 2.75 million tonnes in 1995, according to final figures from Agriculture Ministry official Valentyn Tymoshenko on Thursday.

According to the ministry, this year's harvest will produce about 800,000 tonnes of sunflower oil, down from last year's 1.2 million tonnes. Domestic sunflower oil consumption is about 650,000 tonnes a year.

"The sunflower seed harvest campaign is over and this year's yields were down to 1.13 tonnes per hectare against last year's 1.54 tonnes per hectare," Tymoshenko, deputy head of the ministry's crop department, told Reuters.
Ukraine, one of Eastern Europe's largest sunflower seed growers and oil producers, sowed 1.80 million hectares to sunflower seeds this year compared to 1.78 million in 1995.
The government had forecast this year's total sunflower seed output at 2.70 million tonnes at the beginning of the summer.
Officials blame severe drought during the summer months for the poor outcome.
The Ukrainian government imposed strict limits on sunflower seed exports last month in order to boost domestic sunflower oil production and increase vegetable oil exports.
Ukraine's sunflower seed exports are worth about $50 million, the Statistics Ministry said.
The Agriculture Ministry estimated the total annual capacity of all Ukrainian sunflower seed oil refineries at 2.5 million tonnes.
